en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a park scene with several benches in the foreground and a domed pavilion (gazebo) surrounded by tall weeping willow trees in the background. The reverse side contains standard markings for correspondence and address, indicates it is from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont, and has handwritten numbers and cataloging notations.
